subject: Short product preview — two window options and stakeholder checklist
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@atlasbio.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short product preview — two window options and stakeholder checklist

Hi Samira — great to connect today. Quick recap + next steps so we can lock a short 30-minute preview tailored to Atlas Bioinformatics: 

Recap from today's discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce model inference cost while keeping tail latency under 150ms for batch predictions.
- Key systems involved: inference service (batch jobs), S3 data lake, and existing auth pipeline.
- Success criteria you mentioned: measurable latency improvement in POC and clear cost savings on monthly runs.

Proposed next step: 30-minute product preview (high-level + short tech Q&A). I can keep it focused for your CTO and a single engineer. 

Would you be able to pick one of these two windows? If neither works, send 2–3 alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Option A: Thu, Jun 19 — 10:00–10:30 PT (17:00–17:30 UTC)
Option B: Fri, Jun 20 — 14:00–14:30 PT (21:00–21:30 UTC)

Please also confirm who will join from your side (roles are fine): CTO, infra/ops lead, data scientist, etc. That helps us set the agenda.

Attach: Redwood_MVP_Agenda.pdf (30k) — draft agenda and suggested pre-reads.

If those windows look tight, happy to propose an alternate pair — just tell me what time zone you prefer.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop

Perfect — thanks Samira, and hi Ethan, nice to e-meet. Friday 20 Jun 14:00–14:30 PT is on our side; I’ve tentatively blocked the slot and will send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Two tiny asks so we make the 30 minutes count: 
1) Can you confirm the single most important metric you'd like to improve in the POC (latency at p95, token cost per inference, or throughput)? One sentence is fine.
2) Please confirm attendee roles (CTO + 1 engineer or CTO + infra lead). If you want a deeper tech deep dive, we can expand to 45–60m — otherwise we’ll keep it concise.

Attached: Atlas_MAPlan.xlsx (stub) — I sketched a mutual action plan with ownership placeholders so we can move quickly post-demo.
